about.title: About PyQuest
about.what.title: What is PyQuest?
about.what.text: PyQuest teaches you Python by practising it: 15 levels, short explanations, guided exercises with hints, errors explained in plain language and a mission in every level. The Python you write is real Python, run right in your browser.
about.how.title: How it works
about.how.1: Everything happens in your browser: nothing to install, and the app works without a connection once loaded.
about.how.2: Your progress (points, badges, day streak) stays on your device. You can save it to a file or, if your instance offers it, sync it between devices without creating an account.
about.how.3: No ads, no analytics, no third-party service.
about.how.4: Accessible: full keyboard use, light and dark themes, adjustable text size, sound and voice always switchable off.
